subject.title: fix(gateway): enforce plugin-ownership check in sessions.patch

question: Should the canonical `sessions.patch` fix reject legacy ownerless rows for plugin-runtime callers, matching `sessions.delete`, and use this PR rather than https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/103527 as the landing candidate?
rationale: This PR has the stronger race-safe implementation, but maintainers must own both the upgrade-time authority rule for persisted rows without ownership and selection of the canonical candidate.

options.title: Use this PR and fail closed
options.body: Select this stronger candidate, reject foreign and ownerless rows for plugin runtimes, and retain non-plugin operator management.

options.title: Add a trusted migration
options.body: Keep this PR's transaction-safe shape but assign legacy ownership through an explicit owner-controlled migration before allowing plugin mutation.

options.title: Pause both candidates
options.body: Pause until the legacy authority model and canonical landing path are explicitly decided.
